notes: Energy recovery ventilator point dictionary. Exhaust-side verified in Brick 1.4.4; the post-recovery outdoor-air temperature has no Brick class and is provisional. The sensible-effectiveness computation (ERV-FC-050) uses the three ERV-local temperatures; oat is the site sensor used by frost protection (ERV-FC-051) and typically coincides with erv_oa_entering_temp when the ERV inlet sensor is the site sensor.

points.name: erv_oa_entering_temp
points.description: Outdoor air temperature entering the ERV (upstream of recovery)

s223.pattern: Sensor observes QuantifiableObservableProperty at the ERV outdoor-air inlet via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Outside_Air_Temperature_Sensor (verified via the AHU oat entry); position it upstream of the wheel/exchanger. The effectiveness denominator is (erv_exhaust_temp - this), so its accuracy bounds ERV-FC-050 directly.

points.name: erv_oa_leaving_temp
points.description: Outdoor air temperature leaving the ERV (downstream of recovery, before coils)

s223.pattern: Sensor observes QuantifiableObservableProperty at the ERV outdoor-air outlet via hasProperty

points.notes: No Brick 1.4.4 class names the post-recovery OA temperature (heat-exchanger entering/leaving classes exist only for water); tag the generic air-temperature sensor pattern on the ERV supply outlet. This is the effectiveness numerator's moving term.

points.name: erv_exhaust_temp
points.description: Exhaust air temperature entering the ERV from the building

s223.pattern: Sensor observes QuantifiableObservableProperty at the ERV exhaust inlet via hasProperty

points.notes: brick:Exhaust_Air_Temperature_Sensor grep-verified in Brick 1.4.4. Bind the building-side (entering) exhaust temperature, not the discharge after recovery.

points.name: oat

s223.pattern: Sensor observes QuantifiableObservableProperty at the outdoor-air intake

points.notes: Brick spelling is Outside_ (Outdoor_Air_Temperature_Sensor does not exist). Role-OutdoorAirIntake is 223P's only outdoor role; used by reference instance oa-temp. [ERV dictionary] Brick class and 223P pattern carried over (equipment-independent); consumed by ERV-FC-051's frost test; on many units the same physical sensor as erv_oa_entering_temp.

points.name: erv_frost_prot
points.description: Frost protection active (true while the frost sequence is engaged)
points.notes: No Brick 1.4.4 class; bind the BAS frost-protection status (preheat stage, wheel speed reduction, or bypass modulation — whichever the unit uses).

s223.pattern: EnumeratedObservableProperty (Binary-OnOff) on the ERV via hasProperty
